senses.gloss:
m. (-चः)
A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
f. (-चा)
1 The silk-cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)
2 The plantain, (Musa sapientum.)
n. (-चं)
A plantain, (the fruit.)
E.
मुच to let loose, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
1 A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
2 The silk cotton tree.
3 The plantain tree.
4 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali.
5 A devotee, one who has divested himself of worldly passion and desire.
6 A liberator.
E.
मुच to be let loose, aff. वुन्, or causal form, aff. अच्, and कन् added.

n. (-नं)
Liberating, setting free.
E.
मुच to be free, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be liberated or let loose.
2 To be resigned or given up.
E.
मुच to be loose, causal v., अनीयर् aff.

m. (-सः)
The gum of the silk-cotton tree.
E.
मोच the Bombax, and रस juice; also similar compounds, as माचनिर्य्यास, मोचसार, मोचस्राव, मोचस्रुत्.

m. (-टः)
1 A kind of pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.)
2 Sandal.
3 The heart of the plantain tree.
4 A plantain, (the fruit.)
E.
मोच a plantain, &c., अट to go, (to be used with, to resemble, &c.) aff. अच्.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
1 To be let loose.
2 To be given up.
E.
मुच to be free, यत् aff.
